_what: DB-12's "audit coverage map" (docs/plans/core-database-and-rls-workstream-th.md:795), as data: one row per action SEC-009 and OB-005 name, plus the actions the work package already records as owed to batch 141's audit coverage. For each, the table(s) the action changes, the §8 cell it is, the producer that would write its audit row, and the open blocker that holds it. It is a MAP OF WHAT IS OWED, not a claim that anything is covered: nothing in this repository can write an audit row today (WP-0A-DB-00 open_blockers[21]).
_written_by: The batch 141 preparation draft (A0 /claude/a0_atlas drafting subagent, 2026-10-03). No migration. It approves nothing and decides none of the questions it names.

_sources.SEC-009: docs/plans/meta-security-production-ops-workstream-th.md:164 -- "Audit event contract | MOD-004 | Audit schema + retention | role/credential/publish/delete/billing/support action ระบุ actor/correlation ครบ"
_sources.OB-005: docs/plans/module-contracts-events-jobs-workstream-th.md:337 -- "Audit event v1 | TC-001, EV-001 | security/admin/external actions | audit schema | actor/scope/action/before-after ref/reason; secret/content redaction"
_sources.categories: CTR-AUD-001 action.category and 140_audit.sql's audit_logs_action_category_known carry exactly SEC-009's six: role, credential, publish, delete, billing, support.

_shape.id: unique, dotted, stable; a renamed row is a new row
_shape.action: the action in words, quoted or paraphrased from its source
_shape.source: where the obligation to audit it is written: SEC-009, OB-005, or an open blocker
_shape.category: one of CTR-AUD-001's six action categories, or null when no category fits -- then category_note says why, and that is a finding, not a choice
_shape.tables: schema-qualified tables the action changes, each created by a migration in db/foundation/migrations/; empty only with tables_note
_shape.producer_path: always "UNDECIDED" until Q141-a is answered; trigger, command or worker is that decision
_shape.producer_decision: the plan question that decides producer_path
_shape.section8_cell: the §8 row(s) this action is, each quoted exactly as its first column appears in docs/sprint-0a/sprint-0a-core-erd-rls-retention-th.md §8.1-§8.4, or null with section8_note
_shape.blockers: one or more { index, line, quote }: index into work-packages/WP-0A-DB-00.json open_blockers, its line in that file today, and a phrase the blocker text contains, so a renumbered list fails by name instead of pointing at the wrong blocker

_undecided: producer_path is UNDECIDED on every row. Q141-a (Owner + A1) asks whether an audit row is produced by (A) a database trigger whose SECURITY DEFINER function is owned by a non-request-path role, (B) the application command or worker only, or (C) a hybrid. A row naming a producer would be that decision taken in a lint file.
